title: optimize-evals-1on1-prep-maria-2026-03-04
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Samir (optimize/evals) — prep notes and action items
Date: 2026-03-04
Context: quick sync before the weekly evals review. focus on recent quality regressions observed on the search prompt set (A/B test 2026-02-24 -> 2026-03-01), and next steps for prompt set curation + rollback criteria.

Objectives:
- Understand root causes for regression in A variant (model x-2q) vs control (x-2q-v1).
- Align on immediate mitigations (rollbacks, prompt heuristics) and medium-term fixes (eval expansion, retrain/finetune plan, tokenizer/stop-token checks).
- Confirm owners and deadlines for action items before Friday 2026-03-06 sync.

Agenda:
1) Quick recap of A/B results (metrics + examples) — 5m
2) Hypotheses + triage plan — 10m
3) Action items (who/what/when) — 10m
4) Open questions & asks from infra/research — 5m

Recap (data):
- Experiment: A (x-2q, new quant profile) vs B (x-2q-v1, baseline).
- Traffic: 10k sessions/day sampled; evaluation metric = answer-quality score (human eval) + automated embed-similarity.
- Outcome: A shows -6.2% human QA vs B (stat sig at p<0.05). Automated sim metric down -3.8%.
- Regession concentrated on short-context prompts (<= 120 tokens) and ranking queries (top-k precision drop).
- Error rate (nonsensical hallucinations) up from 0.8% -> 2.4% in A.

Examples to bring to the meeting (copy/paste):
- Prompt: "Find the best way to reset a router that is stuck on a blue light."
  - Control: concise step-by-step, mentions safety. (score 4.2/5)
  - A: verbose, mixes unrelated config commands, suggests unsupported commands. (score 2.0/5)
- Prompt: "Compare plans for data retention across products."
  - Control: structured comparison table.
  - A: omitted retention windows, inserted speculative advice.

Hypotheses:
- Quantization profile change removed a small high-precision kernel used for short-context attention -> degraded fidelity on concise prompts. (H1)
- Tokenization/byte-pair differences in the new build caused subtle shifts for certain punctuation-heavy prompts -> hallucinations (H2)
- Sampling/temperature default changed in runtime config for pooled instances of A (ops mistake) -> more verbose wandering outputs (H3)

Triage steps (what I want to confirm in meeting):
- Check runtime config diffs between A/B: temp/Top-K/Top-P, stop tokens (owner: Samir, due: 2026-03-04 EOD)
- Re-run failing prompts with deterministic decoding (greedy) on both variants to isolate sampling vs weight issue (owner: Maria, due: 2026-03-05)
- Run short-context microbench with and without the new quant kernels (owner: infra eng?) to see perf vs quality tradeoff (ask SRE/serving-runtime)
- Tokenization probe: run tokenization diffs for 200 failing prompts to surface byte-pair splits (owner: Jamie, due: 2026-03-05)

Immediate mitigations (proposed):
- Pause rollout for A and shift 80% of traffic back to control B until root cause identified (if we can do quick rollback) — Ops owner: Samir (ask release-engineering), target: ASAP today 2026-03-04
- Apply prompt-level heuristics: for identified short-context classes, force shorter-completion cap + conservative stop sequences to reduce hallucination surface (owner: Maria + Jamie, prototype by 2026-03-06)
- Add golden prompt set to realtime monitor to trigger automatic rollback on >2% drop (owner: product-optimize, target 2026-03-09)

Medium-term fixes:
- Expand eval set to include more short-context/ranking prompts and add reviewer labels for hallucination types (owner: Maria + research, due 2026-03-20)
- If quant kernel implicated, coordinate with serving-runtime to add a passthrough mode for short-context requests or fallback to float kernel (owner: infra/serving-runtime, start convo 2026-03-05)
- Investigate fine-tuning small high-quality supervision dataset targeted at short-context completions (owner: research, proposal by 2026-04-01)

Action items (explicit):
- Samir: check runtime rollout configs + revert plan; contact release-eng to pause A if possible. (due 2026-03-04 EOD)
- Maria (me): run deterministic replays of 50 failure examples vs control & variant on latest builds + log outputs. (due 2026-03-05)
- Jamie: run tokenization diffs for flagged prompts and produce top-10 tokenization mismatches. (due 2026-03-05)
- Research lead (TBD): schedule short deep-dive if deterministic replays indicate model weight issue. (tentative 2026-03-06)
- Product-optimize: add golden prompt monitor + alert runbook (due 2026-03-09)

Notes-to-self (things to ask Samir live):
- Can we rollback within 15m via existing traffic-split? If not, what's the current blocker?
- Any infra errors or infra-level restarts coincident with rollout window? (check incident logs)
- Are any other customers reporting similar hallucination deltas? correlate with tenant/cfg.

Open questions / decisions needed from manager (for meeting):
- Do we want to require additional preflight checks for quant profile changes (e.g., short-context micro-eval pass)?
- Rollback policy: auto vs manual for degradation >= 2% on golden set?

Misc (links + refs):
- Eval dashboard: https://dash.internal.redwood/evals/run/2026-02-24-abtest
- PR for quant-change: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/789
- Related Jira: JIRA-EVALS-567 (regression triage)

Draft message to send to release-eng if we decide to pause A:
"Heads-up: A/B variant 'x-2q' is showing significant QA regression on short-context prompts (human QA -6.2%). Requesting pause of rollout and revert traffic to control while we triage. Will share failing examples and deterministic replays in 1h. Owner: Samir Patel.

-- End notes --

Still todo in this doc: paste deterministic replay outputs, attach top tokenization diffs, link sample failing sessions. Will move to confluence page if we need a structured post-mortem.
